description: This file contains the definition of the ConnectorHtmlHelper class, which provides utility methods for generating HTML code related to connectors in SuiteCRM, including methods for creating connector buttons and popups with associated JavaScript and formatting logic.

classes.name: ConnectorHtmlHelper
classes.description: A helper class to generate HTML snippets and scripts for connector UI components in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getConnectorButtonCode
methods.description: Returns HTML code for a hover link field with connector buttons, utilizing formatter instances for each source.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Generates HTML for connector source buttons with icons and JavaScript event handlers.

methods.name: getPopup
methods.description: Creates HTML and JavaScript for a popup menu of connector sources, with icons and dynamic JavaScript functions.
